candidates.title: Four Killed as Scorpio Hits Bhavani Devotees in Kakinada District
candidates.excerpt: Four people were killed in a horrific road accident at Kattipudi in Andhra Pradesh’s Kakinada district after a Scorpio car collided with Bhavani devotees who had got down from a bus to have tea. CCTV footage of the accident has surfaced.

candidates.title: Hyderabad: Retired employee loses Rs 11.69 lakh in life certificate fraud
candidates.excerpt: A retired employee allegedly lost Rs 11.69 lakh after cyber fraudsters posing as bank officials tricked him into sharing personal details and his mobile screen during a WhatsApp video call. Police said money was transferred from his fixed deposit and savings accounts.

candidates.title: Elderly man from Hyderabad loses Rs 33.39 lakh in online trading scam
candidates.excerpt: An elderly Hyderabad resident allegedly lost Rs 33.39 lakh after responding to an Instagram advertisement promising profits from online trading. A woman claiming to represent a trading firm allegedly persuaded him to invest. Cybercrime police have registered a case and are investigating.
